text: Wedding reception for about 120 guests. Sit-down dinner, speeches, then dancing. One guest uses a wheelchair — step-free please.
Half-day tech workshop for 40 people on laptops. Need seats facing a screen/projector. No dinner.
MD leaving party, around 80 people. Drinks and canapés then sit down for dinner. Speeches at some point.
Awards night for approximately 200 guests. Everyone should be seated for the ceremony, stage for presenters, lectern, projector for winner slides.
Networking evening for about 150 people — standing reception with high tables and a bar. No sit-down meal.
Charity gala with 300 guests for a formal banquet dinner, stage for speeches, dancing afterwards, full step-free access.
Kids birthday party — about 25 kids and a few parents. Soft drinks, cake table, space for games. Nothing formal.
Product launch for around 90 people. Networking on arrival, then a panel talk with seating facing the stage, plus a projector for slides.
Hi — looking at 60–80 guests for a corporate dinner, banquet style. Bar on the east wall if possible.
Conference keynote then Q&A. Expecting 180 in theatre rows. Stage and lectern required. Wheelchair access essential.
Small workshop, fifteen people, round tables facing a presenter with slides.
Friday drinks for the team — say 45 people standing, high tables, DJ booth and a dance floor later.
Anniversary dinner 100 guests seated. Speeches then dancing. Photo booth would be lovely.
Investor breakfast: 35 people, cabaret seating for a short talk, buffet along the side.
Messy brief: hiya we need somewhere for maybe 50ish for a sit down meal after drinks, cheers Tom
Awards night, everyone seated — 120 covers, stage south wall, projector for the reel.
